description: Find stores where a saved check shows an AI agent can reach checkout, for running shoes, beauty, clothing, home goods, or another product need. Use it for 'where can my agent check out for running shoes?' or 'which stores let an agent reach checkout for <category>?'. Reads real HTTP agent-catalog checks from the last thirty days whose catalog found a product and returned a checkout link. Each store carries its Agent Readiness Grade (grade, null when not graded). Best current grade first (A, then B…); an expired grade ranks after current ones of the same letter; newest checked_at first within a grade. Results are ordered only by published grade and freshness, never by anything else. Pass min_grade to keep only stores with a current grade of that letter or better. This is not a completed order. One tested product is not a promise about another item. No login, browser scan, or model call. Results are advisory. ARC stops before payment.

category.description: Category slug or shopper words such as running shoes

min_grade.description: Optional: keep only stores whose current (not expired) Agent Readiness Grade is this letter or better (A, B, C, D or F). Default none: every store is listed. Expired and not-graded stores are left out when this is set.

q.description: Product need, such as skincare or camping gear

name: find_agent_ready_stores
title: Find a reach-checkout link
